summary: Module docstrings are substantive, accurate and reference-carrying, and every public declaration is documented. Three docstrings overclaim: two attach small-dipole/saturation behaviour that neither the statement nor the definition delivers at every `Qs`, and the opening sentence asserts all three admissibility conditions hold for every target average when the file itself says the third does not.
